remove-dead-outputs.description: Remove usages of outputs removed in this version that had already stopped firing: Overlay's onAnimationStart/onAnimationDone (and OverlayOptions config callbacks), and MenubarSub's menuFocus/menuBlur/menuKeydown.

styleclass-to-class.description: Rewrite styleClass/[styleClass] to class/[class] on selectors whose styleClass input was removed in this version in favor of the native class attribute: p-toast, p-message, p-tag, p-skeleton, p-card, p-radiobutton/p-radioButton/p-radio-button, p-progressbar/p-progressBar/p-progress-bar, p-divider, p-progressspinner/p-progressSpinner/p-progress-spinner, p-timeline, p-toolbar, p-avatar, p-chip, p-inputgroup/p-inputGroup/p-input-group, p-iconfield/p-iconField/p-icon-field, p-inputicon/p-inputIcon/p-input-icon, p-toggleswitch/p-toggleSwitch/p-toggle-switch, p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker, p-metergroup/p-meterGroup/p-meter-group, p-inplace, p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button, p-terminal, p-blockui/p-blockUI/p-block-ui, p-badge, p-checkbox/p-checkBox/p-check-box, p-panel, p-dock, p-accordion, p-knob, p-splitter, p-scrollpanel/p-scrollPanel/p-scroll-panel, p-image, p-editor, p-slider, p-paginator, p-organizationchart/p-organizationChart/p-organization-chart, p-carousel, p-dataview/p-dataView/p-data-view and p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button.

remove-dead-inputs.description: Remove usages of inputs removed in this version that had already stopped doing anything: p-toast/p-toastItem's showTransformOptions, hideTransformOptions, showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-message's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-overlay's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; p-colorpicker/p-colorPicker/p-color-picker's showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions; the deprecated size of p-overlaybadge/p-overlayBadge/p-overlay-badge (use badgeSize); the deprecated transitionOptions of p-fieldset, p-panel and p-accordion (use motionOptions); the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-scrolltop/p-scrollTop/p-scroll-top (use motionOptions); p-togglebutton/p-toggleButton/p-toggle-button's inputId; the deprecated transitionOptions of p-fieldset and p-panel (use motionOptions); the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions (use motionOptions) and ariaCloseLabel of p-popover; the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-confirmpopup (use motionOptions); the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions (use motionOptions) and modalEnterAnimation and modalLeaveAnimation of p-image; the deprecated transitionOptions of p-drawer (use motionOptions); the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions of p-menu (use motionOptions); and the deprecated showTransitionOptions and hideTransitionOptions (use motionOptions) and the never-applied plain of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button. The dead dir input of p-splitbutton/p-splitButton/p-split-button is removed too, but its dir/[dir] bindings are left in place: they keep working as the host element's native dir attribute.

config-overlay-options-signal.description: Rewrite programmatic access to Exhaustive.overlayOptions, which is a signal in this version: assignments become .set(value) and reads become () calls.
